recipe.name: Greek Yoghurt Berry Seed Bowl with Protein Boost
instructions: Spoon yoghurt into a bowl.
Whisk protein powder with a splash of water and stir through yoghurt.
Top with flaxseeds, chia seeds, hemp seeds, oats, berries and almonds.
Serve immediately.

recipe.name: Grilled Chicken & Cottage Cheese Power Salad
instructions: Grill turkey breast slices until cooked through, then slice.
Toss salad greens, tomatoes, cucumber, bell pepper, onion and chickpeas in a large bowl.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice and parsley for dressing and toss through salad.
Top salad with grilled turkey and a dollop of cottage cheese.
Serve immediately.

recipe.name: Mexican Grilled Steak Tacos with Rice and Charred Corn
instructions: Rub flank steak with cumin, chili powder, minced garlic and a little olive oil; let sit 10 minutes.
Grill steak over high heat 3-4 minutes per side to medium-rare, then rest and slice thinly against the grain.
Char corn kernels in a hot dry pan until lightly blackened.
Warm corn tortillas on the grill or a dry skillet.
Fill tortillas with sliced steak, charred corn, diced red onion, cilantro and avocado; squeeze lime juice over.
Serve with a side of warm white rice.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Seasoned Boiled Eggs with Chili-Lime Salt
instructions: Boil eggs for 9-10 minutes until firm, then peel.
Slice eggs in half and sprinkle with sea salt and chili powder.
Serve at room temperature or chilled.

recipe.name: Sardine Pâté on Whole-Grain Toast

ingredients.name: Tinned sardines in olive oil, drained

instructions: Drain sardines and mash with a fork in a bowl.
Mix in yoghurt, lemon juice, dill, and red onion until a coarse pâté forms.
Season with black pepper.
Toast the whole-grain bread slices.
Spread pâté generously over toast and serve immediately.

recipe.name: Tandoori Roast Chicken with Spiced Cauliflower

ingredients.name: Tandoori spice mix (paprika, cumin, coriander, garam masala)

instructions: Mix yoghurt, tandoori spices, garlic, and ginger into a marinade.
Rub chicken breast portion with marinade and let sit 10 minutes.
Roast in a hot oven at 220°C for 15-18 minutes until fully cooked through.
Baste lightly with a touch of ghee before serving.
Slice and serve hot.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Pumpkin Seed and Almond Portion
instructions: Combine pumpkin seeds and almonds in a small bowl.
Serve as a light snack portion.

recipe.name: Classic Baked Beans on Wholegrain Toast with Protein Boost

ingredients.name: canned haricot beans in tomato sauce

instructions: Heat the canned beans in a small saucepan over medium heat until bubbling, about 5 minutes.
Toast the wholegrain bread slices until golden.
Drizzle olive oil over the toast and season beans with black pepper.
Spoon beans over the toast.
Mix protein powder with 150ml cold water and serve alongside as a drink.

recipe.name: Thai Braised Pork Shoulder in Massaman-style Sauce
instructions: Heat a heavy pot and sear the diced pork shoulder until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the massaman curry paste and stir-fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the coconut milk, fish sauce, tamarind paste, and palm sugar, stirring to combine.
Add the shallot, potato, and kaffir lime leaves, then bring to a gentle simmer.
Cover and braise on low heat for 18-20 minutes until the pork is tender and the potato is cooked through.
Stir in crushed roasted peanuts and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Greek Yoghurt with Toasted Walnuts and Honey
instructions: Spoon the Greek yoghurt into a small bowl.
Top with chopped walnuts and drizzle with honey.
Dust lightly with ground cinnamon before serving.

recipe.name: Scrambled Eggs with Smoked Salmon on Whole-Grain Toast
instructions: Crack eggs into a bowl, season with black pepper, and whisk lightly.
Melt butter in a nonstick pan over low-medium heat.
Pour in eggs and stir gently with a spatula until just set and creamy.
Toast the whole-grain bread until golden.
Top toast with scrambled eggs and lay smoked salmon slices over the top.
Garnish with chopped chives and serve immediately.

recipe.name: Japanese Chicken and Vegetable Curry (Katsu-style Sauce, Light)
instructions: Cut chicken tenderloin into bite-sized pieces.
In a small pot, simmer onion and carrot in chicken stock over medium heat until softened, about 8 minutes.
Add chicken pieces and cook until no longer pink, about 6 minutes.
Stir in curry powder and soy sauce.
Mix cornstarch with a splash of cold water and stir into the pot to thicken the sauce.
Simmer 2-3 minutes until sauce is glossy and slightly thickened.
Serve hot as a light curry stew.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Cottage Cheese with Fresh Berries
instructions: Mix whey protein powder into the cottage cheese until well combined.
Top with sliced strawberries and serve chilled.

recipe.name: Berry Cocoa Protein Shake
instructions: Add water to blender jug.
Add protein powder, creatine, oats, cocoa powder, frozen berries and walnuts.
Blend on high for 45-60 seconds until smooth.
Pour into a large glass and serve immediately.

recipe.name: Greek Lemon Chicken and Vegetable Tray Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Toss chicken thighs and chopped vegetables with olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper on a large tray.
Spread evenly and roast for 22-25 minutes, turning once, until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender.
Scatter cherry tomatoes and crumbled feta over the tray in the last 5 minutes of cooking.
Serve hot directly from the tray.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Paprika Cumin Spiced Eggs
instructions: Place eggs in a pot of cold water and bring to a boil.
Boil for 9-10 minutes for firm yolks, then transfer to cold water to cool.
Peel eggs and slice in half.
Sprinkle with smoked paprika, cumin and salt.
Serve with fresh carrot sticks on the side.

recipe.name: Berry Seed Yoghurt Bowl with Protein Boost
instructions: Whisk protein powder into the yoghurt until smooth.
Spoon into a bowl and top with rolled oats.
Scatter blueberries and sliced strawberries over the top.
Sprinkle flaxseeds, chia seeds and hemp seeds evenly across the bowl.
Serve immediately.

recipe.name: Korean Beef and Vegetable Stir Fry (Sogogi Bokkeum)
instructions: Marinate thin beef slices in half the soy sauce, garlic and ginger for 10 minutes.
Heat a wok over high heat with sesame oil until smoking.
Stir fry beef quickly for 2 minutes until browned; remove and set aside.
Add carrot and cabbage to the wok, stir fry 2 minutes, then add zucchini and spring onion.
Return beef to the wok, add remaining soy sauce, gochujang and a splash of water; toss to combine.
Cook 2 more minutes until vegetables are crisp-tender and sauce coats everything.
Sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds and serve hot.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Mixed Nuts and Pumpkin Seed Portion
instructions: Combine almonds, pumpkin seeds and walnuts in a small bowl.
Serve as a quick portable snack.

recipe.name: Mackerel Pâté on Toasted Whole-Grain Bread
instructions: Drain mackerel well and flake into a bowl.
Mash with yoghurt, lemon juice, dill, minced red onion and black pepper until a coarse pâté forms.
Toast the whole-grain bread slices until golden and crisp.
Spread the mackerel pâté generously over the toast and serve immediately.

recipe.name: Grilled Lamb Kofta with Charred Vegetables, Hummus and Bulgur
instructions: In a bowl, combine ground lamb with garlic, parsley, cumin, coriander, allspice and salt. Mix well and shape into 4 small elongated koftas, pressing onto skewers.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to high heat. Grill koftas for 3-4 minutes per side until charred outside and cooked through.
Toss zucchini, red pepper and tomato halves with a little salt and grill alongside the koftas until softened and charred at the edges, about 8-10 minutes.
Cook bulgur wheat according to package instructions in salted water until tender; fluff with a fork.
Plate the koftas with grilled vegetables, a dollop of hummus and the bulgur on the side. Serve hot.

recipe.name: Greek Yoghurt with Honey and Walnuts
instructions: Spoon Greek yoghurt into a bowl.
Drizzle with honey and sprinkle chopped walnuts on top.
Serve immediately.

aggregated_ingredients.garlic, minced: 80g total minced (for tacos, tandoori chicken, massaman pork, Korean beef)
aggregated_ingredients.ginger, minced: 40g total minced (for tandoori chicken, Korean beef)
aggregated_ingredients.onion (red/yellow, diced): 330g total diced (red onion for tacos, red onion for Greek tray bake, shallot for massaman pork, onion for Japanese curry)
aggregated_ingredients.carrot, diced/julienned: 280g total prepped (diced for Japanese curry, julienned for Korean beef)
aggregated_ingredients.zucchini, sliced: 600g total sliced (for Greek tray bake, Korean beef stir fry)
aggregated_ingredients.chicken protein trim/cut: chicken breast, tenderloin, and thighs portioned and trimmed together (tandoori, Japanese curry, Greek tray bake)

timeline.name: Start Massaman Pork Braise
timeline.description: Sear diced pork shoulder in a heavy pot, add curry paste, coconut milk, fish sauce, tamarind, palm sugar, shallot, potato and kaffir lime leaves; bring to simmer then cover and let braise unattended on low heat while other prep continues.

timeline.name: Preheat oven and start Greek Lemon Chicken Tray Bake
timeline.description: Toss chicken thighs and chopped vegetables (using aggregated onion and zucchini prep) with oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper; spread on tray and place in oven to roast unattended, adding feta and cherry tomatoes near the end.

timeline.name: Aggregated chopping: onions, garlic, ginger, carrots, zucchini, cilantro
timeline.description: Batch-dice all red and yellow onions/shallots for tacos, Greek tray bake and massaman pork; mince all garlic and ginger for tandoori chicken, massaman pork and Korean beef; dice/julienne carrots for Japanese curry and Korean beef; slice zucchini for Greek tray bake and Korean stir fry; chop cilantro/coriander for tacos and massaman pork.

timeline.name: Marinate and roast Tandoori Chicken
timeline.description: Mix yoghurt, tandoori spices, and portion of aggregated garlic/ginger into marinade; rub onto chicken breast and let sit, then roast in hot oven (can share oven timing with tray bake if staggered) until cooked through.

timeline.name: Prep and marinate Korean Beef
timeline.description: Slice beef sirloin thinly; marinate with portion of aggregated soy sauce, garlic and ginger while other components cook.

timeline.name: Prep steak for Mexican Tacos and grill
timeline.description: Rub flank steak with cumin, chili powder, aggregated garlic and olive oil; let sit, then grill and rest before slicing thinly against the grain.

timeline.name: Char corn and warm tortillas for tacos
timeline.description: Char grilled corn kernels in a hot dry pan; warm tortillas on skillet; slice avocado and prep lime juice for taco assembly.

timeline.name: Cook Japanese Chicken and Vegetable Curry
timeline.description: Simmer aggregated diced onion and carrot in chicken stock; add cut chicken tenderloin pieces, curry powder and soy sauce; thicken with cornstarch slurry and simmer until glossy.

timeline.name: Stir-fry Korean Beef and Vegetables
timeline.description: Stir-fry marinated beef in hot wok with sesame oil, then aggregated carrot, cabbage and zucchini; return beef with remaining soy sauce and gochujang; toss and finish with sesame seeds.

timeline.name: Finish and rest Massaman Pork
timeline.description: Stir in crushed roasted peanuts, let rest off heat, then garnish with reserved chopped coriander before portioning.

timeline.name: Portion, label and refrigerate all dishes
timeline.description: Divide all six finished dishes into individual airtight containers for their respective eating days; label with dish name and date. All items are fridge-only per storage rules (each eaten within 1 day of prep window), no freezer steps required.

timeline.name: Cool and stage in fridge
timeline.description: Allow portioned containers to cool briefly on counter before sealing into the fridge to avoid condensation buildup; this passive cooling runs alongside final cleanup.
